policy: Publish new code, bibliographical metadata, source locators and project-authored coverage summaries. Hold full inherited readings, translations, scans and crops outside the public repository until a source-specific permission basis is documented.

sources.title: Learn Ahom manuscripts and images
sources.basis: Terms restrict free content to personal, non-commercial use and require written permission for reproduction or distribution.

sources.title: SEAlang / Ahom Dictionary Resource Project
sources.basis: Search index shows a general Creative Commons reuse statement, but the Ahom resource pages could not be retrieved and the exact licence and its scope for these readings were not established. No bulk redistribution in this release.

sources.title: Six analytical transcriptions and inherited English editions
sources.basis: Source credits are preserved. The supplied working packages do not grant a clear public redistribution licence for the complete inherited readings. Private transformation only; source links public.

sources.title: Tabassum and Morey (2010), Linguistic features of the Ahom Bar Amra
sources.basis: Bibliographical reference and factual coverage metadata only. No study pages, figures or complete source transcriptions are newly published.

sources.title: Ahom-Buranji, 1930; inherited Atlas scan derivatives
sources.basis: The prior import branch is preserved. This release does not carry scan images or crops onto main; a source-specific reproduction basis has not been established in this session.

sources.title: Noto Serif Ahom font
sources.basis: SIL Open Font License 1.1 retained verbatim in dist/assets/OFL-Ahom.txt.

sources.title: New application code
sources.basis: MIT; copied Atlas helpers and visual identity retain the original project licence. This does not relicense source content.

sources.title: Tai-Ahom and Nanzhao: Regional connections, migration traditions and the limits of dynastic ancestry
sources.basis: Catalogue metadata and an attributed research summary only. The PDF, source plates, manuscript scans, companion archive and third-party publications are not copied into the public repository or build. Their reproduction permissions have not been established here. The existing Google Drive access settings are preserved.
